body.name: Finite degeneracy-safe strict-gap certificate
body.construction: \(\mathsf{GapCert}=(F_0,\ldots,F_r,z_1,\ldots,z_r,\eta_1,\ldots,\eta_r,y^\circ,y_N,\lambda_D,I_N,I_D)\), where the face chain, affine exposing multipliers, and \(y^\circ\) satisfy \texttt{def:facial-dual}, \(B_{\mathrm{nested}}y_N=d_{\mathrm{nested}}\) and \(y_N\in\mathcal K_{\mathrm{nested}}\), \(c_{\mathrm{deep}}-B_{\mathrm{deep}}^{\top}\lambda_D\in F_{\min,\mathrm{deep}}^*\), all nonrational entries use \(\mathbb A_{\mathrm{rep}}\), and the outward-rounded rational intervals satisfy \(c_{\mathrm{nested}}^{\top}y_N\in I_N\), \(d_{\mathrm{deep}}^{\top}\lambda_D\in I_D\), and \(\sup I_N<\inf I_D\).
inputs: exact algebraic numbers and rational intervals
